clips.title: The story
paras: Return to Bellowfiz is a short delivery quest in Dun Morogh where an adventurer brings a cask of local Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot. It concludes a local favor, rewarding the thirsty driver with a welcome drink.

Return to Bellowfiz is an errand in the snowy reaches of Dun Morogh. After aiding with local hunting, an adventurer receives a freshly brewed cask of Evershine with instructions to carry it straight to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot. It is a straightforward favor that highlights the informal camaraderie and mutual support that keep the cold frontier running.

Steelgrill's Depot serves as a busy center of mechanical testing, vehicle maintenance, and gnomish craft just outside Kharanos. For pilots stationed out in the freezing winds, nothing hits the spot quite like a draught of strong local drink. Pilot Bellowfiz wastes no time upon delivery, eager to uncork a bottle on the spot and enjoy the fruits of local labor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here's your cask of Evershine, friend. And again, thank you for the hunting earlier.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, this will do just fine. I think I'll open a bottle right now and have a taste...
